# BAD-019 — Community scene library where players publish scenes to a shared, moderated catalog

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 12 (added 2026-08-16), with item 13 (the social feed for shared cuts) as its later phase.

What exists as of 2026-09-14: a curated hosted catalog (scenes.badtakes.io on R2, published by the operator with scripts/showcase.mjs, browsable in the web app and filtered for titles that cannot be defended), the desktop's community catalog, and collab scene uploads between invited members. What does not exist: any way for a player to publish their own scene for strangers to find and install.

Shape: upload a created scene (the existing export zip) to a shared library, then browse and install other people's scenes from inside the app, installs reusing packs:importZips on desktop and the catalog download path on the web.

Blocked by [[BAD-010]] (DMCA agent and takedown path). Uploads are movie and TV clips, so hosting them for the public makes Bad Takes a UGC host; a registered agent, a takedown flow, terms and a report and moderation path are prerequisites. Also consider App Store guideline 1.2 (report and block for user-generated content) before it reaches iOS, and the per-title filtering the curated catalog already applies.

Cost: scenes with video run tens to hundreds of MB, so bandwidth dominates; R2 has no egress fees, which is why the catalog already lives there.

Start with a design note for Eric, not code: moderation model (pre-review or report-driven), who can publish (free or paid), storage quota, and whether it is the curated catalog opened up or a separate shelf.
